note: The picture gallery of the Maison de Couture: clarity, ugliness, finery and excess. Feminine nouns to the left of x=905, masculine to the right (the column stands just left of the line). The mature word virilité appears only as museum wall text on a blank plaque. The glazed garden door at the back opens a zoom onto the terrace (R_abs_beauty_03_z1); it is not an exit. The doorway on the left goes back to the showroom atelier.
